title: hedysarum pogonocarpum subsp. pannosum
intro: Hedysarum pogonocarpum subsp. pannosum, commonly known as Pogonocarpus, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is a shrub that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Hedysarum pogonocarpum subsp. pannosum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, antipyretic, and spasmolytic effects.
